weather_refresh_interval_minutes.description: How often the background weather refresh runs, in minutes. WorkManager enforces a 15-minute minimum.

radar_frame_interval_ms.description: Delay between radar animation frames, in milliseconds. Higher is slower. Values outside 100–5000 fall back to 850 in-app.

radar_enabled.description: Hide the radar card if RainViewer or OpenStreetMap tiles become unavailable

walk_card_enabled.description: Show the "time to walk the dog" card on the current-weather screen

openweather_api_key.description: Replacement OpenWeather API key, used by both apps from their next launch. Empty uses the key built into each app. Not secret: Remote Config values reach every device.

open_meteo_enabled.description: Use Open-Meteo for forecasts of cities with coordinates; off falls back to OpenWeatherMap

daily_weather_notifications_enabled.description: Post the 8:30 AM morning briefing. Walk time and rain alerts have their own switches in Settings.

foreground_refresh_min_minutes.description: Skip the silent refresh when the app returns to the foreground if this city was fetched within this many minutes. 0 always refreshes. Pull-to-refresh is never throttled.

walk_hot_pavement_c.description: Pavement temperature, in °C, at or above which the walk rating is Paws hot and that hour is not walkable. Valid 40–70; anything else uses 52.

walk_warm_pavement_c.description: Pavement temperature, in °C, at or above which the Today Paw check tile says "Getting hot" and that hour is not suggested for a walk. Valid 30–65 and below walk_hot_pavement_c; anything else uses 45 (or 7 below walk_hot_pavement_c).

walk_icy_pavement_c.description: Pavement temperature, in °C, below which the Today Paw check tile says "Icy, watch for salt" after rain or snow ("Below freezing" otherwise). Valid -20–10; anything else uses 0.

walk_dangerous_pavement_c.description: Pavement temperature, in °C, at or above which the Today Paw check tile says "Dangerously hot" (57.2 is 135 °F). Valid 45–80 and above walk_hot_pavement_c; anything else uses 57.2 (or 5 above walk_hot_pavement_c).

walk_max_rain_chance.description: An hour is walkable only when its rain chance, in percent, is below this. Valid 0–100; anything else uses 30.

walk_comfort_min_c.description: Coldest feels-like temperature, in °C, at which an hour counts as comfortable for a walk. Valid -20–20; anything else uses 3. Must be below walk_comfort_max_c, or both use their defaults.

walk_comfort_max_c.description: Warmest feels-like temperature, in °C, at which an hour counts as comfortable for a walk. Valid 15–40; anything else uses 27. Must be above walk_comfort_min_c, or both use their defaults.

walk_hours_start.description: First local hour (0–23, inclusive) a walk may be suggested; 7 = 7 AM. Valid 0–23; anything else uses 7. Must be before walk_hours_end, or both use their defaults.

walk_hours_end.description: Last local hour (0–23, inclusive) a walk may be suggested; 20 = 8 PM. Valid 0–23; anything else uses 20. Must be after walk_hours_start, or both use their defaults.

pet_hot_threshold_c.description: Feels-like temperature, in °C, at or above which the pets look hot and the walk rating is Paws hot. Valid 20–45; anything else uses 30. Must be above pet_cold_threshold_c, or both use their defaults.

pet_cold_threshold_c.description: Feels-like temperature, in °C, at or below which the pets look cold and the walk rating is Too cold. Valid -20–10; anything else uses 0. Must be below pet_hot_threshold_c, or both use their defaults.

analytics_enabled.description: Kill switch: false stops all usage-analytics events and turns Firebase Analytics collection off on every install, on top of the user's own Share usage statistics setting.

rain_notifications_enabled.description: Kill switch for rain and snow alerts, for everyone: false stops them and hides their switch in Settings (users' own choice is kept)

walk_time_notifications_enabled.description: Kill switch for the Walk time nudge, for everyone: false stops it and hides its switch in Settings (users' own choice is kept)

ios_min_supported_version.description: iOS versions below this (for example 1.2) show only an update screen. Blank never asks.

ios_min_recommended_version.description: iOS versions below this show an update banner; Not now hides it for a week. Blank never asks.

ios_app_store_url.description: App Store link for the iOS Update button. Blank: the update screen says to update from the App Store.

android_min_supported_version.description: Android versions below this (for example 1.2) show only an update screen. Blank never asks.

android_min_recommended_version.description: Android versions below this show an update banner; Not now hides it for a week. Blank never asks.

air_quality_enabled.description: Kill switch for air quality: false stops fetching it, hides the Air quality tile, and the walk planner ignores the air

walk_bad_air_band.description: Air quality band (0 good to 5 worst) from which hours aren't suggested for a walk and the walk rating is Bad air. 3 is US "Unhealthy" and Europe's "Poor". Valid 1–5; anything else uses 3.

tile_feels_like_enabled.description: Feels like tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone

tile_wind_enabled.description: Wind tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone

tile_humidity_enabled.description: Humidity tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone

tile_paw_check_enabled.description: Paw check tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone

tile_uv_enabled.description: UV index tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone. Starts off; while off, UV stays in the Daylight tile

tile_daylight_enabled.description: Daylight tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone

tile_sky_enabled.description: Sky tile on the Today screen: false hides it for everyone
